_comment: Cases where the obvious handle failed and the affiliation-search fallback found the real channel. Each one is a creator the first attempt alone would have dropped.

rescues.name: Chris Voss
gateEvidence: affiliation in channel description/title: Black Swan Group, Never Split the Difference
failedBecause: handle @chrisvoss: name matches but nothing ties this channel to the person — a name match is not an identity match
rescues.note: The batch-02 exclusion this whole change came from. Outcome: the fallback found the right channel (@NegotiationMastery), which was ALREADY in batch 01 as `negotiationmastery`. So no creator was actually missing — but the batch-02 UNVERIFIED note claiming 'no channel for the negotiator was found' was wrong, and has been corrected. The mechanism is proven: the gate rejected the 10,150-upload podcast channel named 'Chris Voss' and the affiliation search found the real one.
